day01: Day one of making my dream game.
It's called, The Bear Must Eat.
Office bears clock out at five, and eat the fish out of *your* pond.
And me? I'm the fox. It's *my* pond.
Right now it's literally just squares.
This brown square is a bear. Don't question it.
First test. Walk to the pond. Easy.
Tomorrow, fish. What fish do I add?
day02: They just swim around, doing fish stuff.
Two happy fish bump into each other... boom. Baby fish.
Then I changed *one* line of code, and this happened.
Every. Single. Fish. In the corner. *Why?*
I forgot to normalize *one* vector. One.
Fixed it. Now the pond fills up on its own.
day03: and every single bear *sprints* to my pond.
They cannonball in, grab a fish, and pay me five coins.
This is the whole game. I love it.
They're just standing in the water. Confused. Same.
day04: Day four. The orange square has to go.
That orange square? That's me. Embarrassing.
So I rebuilt myself out of tiny cubes. Layer by layer.
Then I gave myself way too many animations.
day05: This is office bear. He walks, he eats, he *roars*.
Then I made more. Grandma, construction guy, and the CEO.
Which one are you? Be honest.
Time to promote the brown squares.
The world is still squares though. Tomorrow.
day06: So I drew the whole thing.
Grass, trees, flowers, rocks, lily pads, and real fish.
Then I added day and night.
Night is my favorite. Not even close.
Same pond as day one, by the way.
day07: Day seven. You guys asked for stuff.
Someone said add a banana fish. Say less.
Drew it pixel by pixel. Brown spots, little stem for a tail.
Then I put it in the game.
It's a banana. It's a fish. It's *gorgeous*.
What do I add next? Comment it.
day08: You can build a whole restaurant around the pond now.
Tables, a barbecue, a jukebox, and a neon sign.
And at five p.m., they actually use it.
My little bear restaurant. I'm so proud.
day09: Day nine. The game worked, but it felt *dead*.
Comic words. Squash and stretch. Screen shake. Coins. And *way* too many sound effects.
day10: Day ten. I made a title screen.
There's always a bear in the pond. *Always*.
Ten days ago, this was a brown square walking on water.
There's still *so* much to do. Do I keep going?
